summary: All 143 files in this work unit contain substantial formal mathematical content and should remain in the primary search index. The CPythonListsort directory (112 files) provides a complete formalization of CPython's Timsort algorithm with transcriptions, assembly-level safety/cost proofs, and correctness proofs. The FC directory (9 files) contains formal solutions to open mathematical problems (Erdos, Green, OEIS sequences, graph conjectures, quantum problems). Every file inspected contains definitions, theorems, lemmas, and proofs — none are pure import aggregators without mathematical content (Code.lean only imports but also serves as the root module with a descriptive docstring; per FILTER-007 it must be retained until auxiliary navigation is verified).
